why: Hand arithmetic from the evidence alone: revenue through the 17 July close is $5,100 (e3). From 18 July the competitor's posted $19.99 clearance (e4) puts Fernhaven in the evidenced undercut regime of 7 units per day, matching the comparable March episode (e5), and no Fernhaven price change can occur before the 3 August review (e6, e10), so the regime holds through 31 July given the clearance runs through 31 August (e4). Over the remaining 14 selling days (e9, e7) at 7 units per day and $25.00 each (e1): 14 x 7 x $25 = $2,450. Total: $5,100 + $2,450 = $7,550, below the $8,000 threshold, with stock never binding (e8).
